fact: On 8 September 2026 the Minister of Communications witnessed the signing of Africa Data Centres Egypt by Vodafone Business, Elsewedy Electric and Cassava Technologies, expected to draw about USD 200 million in its first phase and USD 1 billion at full 200 MW capacity.
